title: Optimization of ultrasound-assisted extraction of polyphenols in Avicennia officinalis
author: Nguyen, Ngoc-Van Thi
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Combine Avicennia officinalis plant material with methanol containing 55.27% (v/v) methanol at a liquid‑to‑solid ratio of 14 mL per gram of sample.

steps.title: Ultrasound extraction under optimal conditions
steps.instruction: Subject the mixture to ultrasound‑assisted extraction at 48.8 °C for 9.66 minutes.

steps.title: Identify compounds by UFLC‑DAD
steps.instruction: Analyze the resulting extract using ultra‑fast liquid chromatography coupled to a diode array detector (UFLC‑DAD) to identify phenolic acids and flavonoids.

steps.title: Quantify phenolics and flavonoids
steps.instruction: Quantify the identified phenolic acids and flavonoids, reporting concentrations that may range from 0.319 ± 0.022 to 3.524 ± 0.125 mg g⁻¹ in the methanol extract.
